after.zh: 你看到的每一张图，都只是一格一格的数字。
after.en: Every image you see is just a grid of numbers, cell by cell.

t.zh: 图在电脑里是一张数字表，每格是一个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: Inside a computer an image is a table of numbers, each cell a <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>.

brief.en: Connect the input to the output.

hint.zh: 从「输入」右边的圆点拖到「输出」左边的圆点。
hint.en: Drag from the dot on the right of “Input” to the dot on the left of “Output”.
